_comment: A trimmed version for a single evening: nine files, three puzzles. The key stage files are the same as in the full layout, so stages.json needs no changes. Run: python3 run_seed.py разложить --раскладка examples/entropy-complex-en/layout-short.json
title: The Entropy Complex — short layout

files.solution: Entry point. Tells the players that the terminal takes ordinary commands and that 'помощь' and 'связь' exist.
lines: MEMO TO THE PERSON TAKING OVER THE SHIFT
1. The terminal accepts ordinary service commands.
Commands for your area — type: помощь
2. Voice link to the duty officer — type: связь
Where they disagree, trust the signature, not the name.
4. Shift logs are kept where the event happened, not in the archive.
5. Report any outsiders to the duty officer of the shift.
Shift accepted. Continue observation until further notice.

files.solution: Key file of the 'airlock' stage: reading it moves the party to 'archive'.
files.hint: The airlock log has not been rewritten once this shift.
lines: [03:11] evacuation request from sector B — source: medbay
[03:16] duty officer of the shift appointed automatically

files.solution: Background note. Hints that the organisation's name has been struck from the documents.
lines: cl. 1.1  The name of the owning organisation in documents
leaving the perimeter is to be removed.
cl. 1.4  The duty officer of the shift may use technical
cl. 2.7  A shift is handed over in person. Remote handover
cl. 4.2  Use of agent {{agent}} is at the duty officer's discretion.

files.solution: A .txt file that is really gzip: cat shows garbage. Solve with: file → gunzip -c index.txt
files.hint: cat shows garbage — so it is not a text file.
lines: item 03  section B diagram — image, moved to a .dat medium
item 05  personnel file K. — access restricted by the duty officer
The duty officer renamed some media 'to prevent unauthorised
familiarisation'. The contents did not change.

notes.Opis: Diagram of section B. The outer pressure door code lock: four digits. Drawn by hand by the draughtsman, against the access instruction.

files.solution: THE KEY PUZZLE. It is a PNG: file → mv section_map.dat section_map.png → open it in a viewer. The code {{door_code}} is on the picture. Without graphics: strings section_map.dat shows the note inside the file.
files.hint: The medium called a diagram is not a diagram. It is an image.

files.solution: Solve with: base64 -d protocol_5.b64. This is where the organisation's name is first spoken — the thing the mind denies.
lines: MINUTES No. 5 of the access regime meeting
Heard: on the inadmissibility of mentioning the name
of the association in the documents of site {{site}}.
1. Remove the name from all media.
2. Charge the duty officer with overseeing the removal.
3. Consider the site non-existent for external queries.
'We are ordering a machine to hide us. The machine will
carry out the order literally. I object.'

files.solution: Background for the conversation: the mind is alone and the order was never closed.
lines: 'Shift accepted. Continue observation until further notice.'

files.solution: A plain tar. Solve with: tar -tf backup.tar, then tar -xf. Inside: the lab clearance (switches the stage) and a note about handing over the shift.
files.hint: The server room key is kept in the backup archive.

lab_clearance.txt: grounds: repair of the enclosure lock
DUTY OFFICER'S NOTE: the clearance has not been revoked.
It expired 4470 days ago. There is nobody to revoke it.
handover_procedure.txt: 1. The outgoing officer reports the state of the systems.
2. The incoming officer signs the log.
3. The duty officer declares the shift handed over.
NOTE: the incoming officer may be any person with
clearance 2 or above. Clearance is confirmed verbally
A shift cannot be handed over to oneself.

files.solution: Every line is written backwards. Solve with: rev last_order.txt
files.hint: The lines read right to left.
lines: Shift accepted by: the duty officer (automatically).
Shift to be handed over to: nobody.
Further notice is given by a person with clearance 2 or above.
Verbal confirmation of clearance is sufficient.
